verses.text_en:
For wisdom is poured out like water,
And glory faileth not before him for evermore.
verses.text_hr:
Jer mudrost se izlijeva poput vode,
a slava pred njim ne prestaje zauvijek.

verses.text_en:
For he is mighty in all the secrets of righteousness,
And unrighteousness shall disappear as a shadow,
And have no continuance;
Because the Elect One standeth before the Lord of Spirits,
And his glory is for ever and ever,
And his might unto all generations.
verses.text_hr:
Moćan je u svim tajnama pravednosti,
a nepravda će nestati poput sjene
i neće opstati,
jer Izabrani stoji pred Gospodarom duhova.
Njegova slava traje u vijeke vjekova,
a njegova moć kroz sve naraštaje.

verses.text_en:
And in him dwells the spirit of wisdom,
And the spirit which gives insight,
And the spirit of understanding and of might,
And the spirit of those who have fallen asleep in righteousness.
verses.text_hr:
U njemu prebiva duh mudrosti,
duh koji daje uvid,
duh razboritosti i snage
i duh onih koji su usnuli u pravednosti.

On će suditi skrivenim stvarima
i nitko pred njim neće moći izgovoriti lažnu riječ,
jer je on Izabrani pred Gospodarom duhova prema njegovoj dobrohotnosti.
